results.title: Ghana Stammering Association calls for inclusion and an end to stigma
results.content: The Ghana Stammering Association (GSA) has called for greater understanding and inclusion of people who stammer, urging Ghanaians to create spaces where everyone can communicate without fear of ridicule or discrimination.

results.title: Akosua Manu calls on Vice President to intervene in Obuasi SHTS abuse case
results.content: The Advisor on Gender and Social Protection to Dr Mahamudu Bawumia, Akosua Manu, has called on Vice President Prof. Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang to use her office and influence to ensure justice for students at Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) following allegations of sexual abuse.

results.title: World Bank President warns 1.2bn young people will compete for 400m jobs in next 15 years
results.content: Making remarks at the 2026 World Bank/International Monetary Fund Annual Meetings Plenary in Bangkok, Thailand, he said this generation will shape the next century. Therefore, “the choices we make today will help determine how”.

results.title: Obuasi Agrifair promotes agribusiness, food security and youth employment
results.content: Stakeholders in the agriculture sector in Obuasi and two local municipal assemblies are forging ahead to transform the town from its known status as a gold mining community to a rich agricultural hub to feed the country.

results.title: GoldBod must be commended for successes chalked up – Mahama
results.content: President John Mahama has commended the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod) for its contribution to the growth of gold exports, increased foreign exchange earnings and efforts to promote responsible small-scale mining.

results.title: France wants curfews in some areas after weekend of riots
results.content: France's central government asked some local authorities to impose curfews ​and faced pressure over security failings on Monday after a weekend of riots and looting borne out of nationwide anti-government protests.

results.title: I don’t have the bandwidth for two wives – Sarkodie
results.content: Ghanaian rapper Sarkodie has ruled out taking a second wife, saying he does not have the capacity to handle the stress that would come with it.

results.title: Galamsey: President Mahama commends Newmont for reclaiming 800 acres of degraded land
results.content: President John Mahama has commended Newmont for reclaiming 800 acres of degraded land and putting it to use for crop farming.

results.title: NDC youth charged to propagate gov’t policies and programs, lead grassroots mobilization
results.content: Members of the Youth Wing of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) have been urged to double their propagation of government policies and programs, grassroots mobilization efforts, and expand membership drives to secure the party’s victory and maintain its parliamentary majority in the 2028 general elections.

results.title: Ablakwa announces global database of Ghanaians needing consular support
results.content: The Minister for Foreign Affairs, Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, has announced that the Foreign Ministry has established what he describes as the first comprehensive database of Ghanaians living across the world, with particular attention to those requiring diplomatic and consular assistance.

results.title: Mahama pushes local gold refining to boost Ghana’s economic gains
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama says Ghana is working to increase the economic benefits it derives from its gold resources by expanding local assaying, refining and related services.

results.title: Missing signatures, mismatched records underpin South Africa GH¢16.4m evacuation gap – Bosome-Freho MP
results.content: Member of Parliament for Bosome-Freho and the Deputy Ranking Member on Parliament’s Foreign Affairs Committee, Nana Asafo-Adjei Ayeh, says missing signatures and discrepancies in payment records underpin the NPP’s concerns over GH¢16.4 million in expenditure on the evacuation of Ghanaians.

results.title: BTS Africa and CDKN Ghana explore Microsoft partnership for climate literacy and youth engagement
results.content: Beyond the Science Africa (BTS Africa) and the Climate and Development Knowledge Network (CDKN Ghana) are exploring opportunities to strengthen climate literacy, youth engagement and community-led environmental solutions through potential collaboration with Microsoft. The discussions followed an engagement with Microsoft employees under the company's Africa Giving Campaign, which provided a platform for the climate-focused organisations to explore how Microsoft's technical expertise, digital tools and employee volunteerism could support their work. The engagement focused on a key challenge in climate action: translating scientific knowledge into practical solutions that young people and local communities can apply to environmental problems.

results.title: Gyakie questions importance of artistes following fans on social media
results.content: Ghanaian singer Gyakie has questioned the importance of artistes following fans on social media, saying meaningful interactions matter more than the follow button.

results.title: Global South urged to unite despite differences – Prof Opoku-Agyemang
results.content: Vice-President Professor Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang has urged countries in the Global South to strengthen cooperation despite differences in their political systems, histories and development experiences. Speaking at the 2026 Global South Academic Forum in Shanghai, China, she said countries must learn to disagree respectfully while pursuing common development goals, particularly amid growing global polarisation. Professor Opoku-Agyemang stressed that unity should not require countries to hold identical positions on every issue. “A unified voice should not be a uniform voice,” she said.

results.title: UTAG-UG gives gov’t October 20 ultimatum to avert strike over unpaid allowances
results.content: The University of Ghana branch of the University Teachers Association of Ghana (UTAG-UG) has given the government until Tuesday, October 20, 2026, to demonstrate its commitment to paying lecturers’ Book and Research Allowances (BRA) or risk a possible strike.

results.content: The Director of Communications of the Bank of Ghana, Mr Bernard Otabil, has urged members of the Bank of Ghana Press Corps to humanise monetary policy and translate technical policy decisions into stories that reflect the lives of ordinary Ghanaians. results.title: AU Commissioner cites GoldBod as model for mineral sector reforms in Africa
results.content: African Union Commissioner for Economic Development, Trade, Tourism, Industry and Minerals, Francisca Tatchououp Belobe, has pointed to Ghana’s Gold Board (GoldBod) as an example of how reforms in the mineral sector can help African countries strengthen foreign exchange reserves, support currency stability and build more resilient economies.

results.title: 12,000 acres of Ghana’s land affected by galamsey – Mahama
results.content: According to President Mahama, heavily armed illegal miners had occupied the affected reserves, leading to their designation as red zones for enforcement officers before they were recently recovered.

results.title: Vice President urges political parties to prioritise policy research and institutional knowledge
results.content: Vice-President Professor Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang has urged political parties to prioritise policy research and institutional knowledge to strengthen governance and sustain effective administration beyond changes in leadership. Speaking at the 2026 Global South Academic Forum in Shanghai, China, she said political parties needed strong institutions and well-developed policies to remain effective regardless of changes in their leadership. She stressed that winning elections and governing effectively were distinct responsibilities, requiring parties to build the capacity to translate campaign promises into meaningful outcomes for citizens.

results.title: ‘You cannot have a stable economy with people suffering’ -Bawumia
results.content: Former Vice-President and New Patriotic Party (NPP) presidential candidate, Dr Mahamudu Bawumia, has criticised the National Democratic Congress (NDC) government over the economic conditions facing Ghanaians, describing the situation as a tale of two economies: a paper economy and a pocket economy.

results.title: 48 of Ghana’s 288 forest reserves affected by galamsey – Mahama
results.content: President John Mahama has disclosed that illegal mining affected 48 of Ghana’s 288 forest reserves, saying the affected reserves have since been recovered and are undergoing reclamation.

results.title: Asantehene backs government’s mineral policies, says the approach reflects Nkrumah’s vision
results.content: The Asantehene, Otumfuo Osei Tutu II, has backed the government’s mineral policies, including the establishment of the Ghana Gold Board (GoldBod), saying they are helping Ghana take greater control of its mineral resources and retain more value from its gold.

results.title: No, misdemeanours do attract a prison term in Ghana, even 25 years
results.content: A few weeks ago, a certain wind began to blow through our legal streets, and it appears to be gaining momentum. It carries a seductive but specious dictum that misdemeanours in Ghana attract no custodial sentence, only a fine; that bail in such cases is a matter of right; and that a judge who refuses it deserves to be rusticated to the classroom.

results.title: Digital tracking helps NPA verify UPPF claims by oil marketers – NPA CEO
results.content: The Chief Executive of the National Petroleum Authority (NPA), Edudzi Tamakloe, says the deployment of technology since 2020 has helped reduce human interference in the determination and payment of claims under the UPPF to Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs).

results.title: No further action against government adviser’s wife over Palestine Action post, police say
results.content: Police say no further action will be taken against the wife of the government's national security adviser after she posted on social media referencing Palestine Action.

results.title: Bomb threat forces Israel to Austria flight into emergency landing
results.content: An Austrian Airlines flight from Israel to Austria was forced to divert to Bulgaria after a reported bomb threat.

results.title: About 200 firearms seized from illegal miners – Mahama
results.content: President John Mahama says about 200 firearms have been seized from illegal miners as part of the government’s efforts to combat galamsey.

results.title: ‘Come and invest’ – Lands Minister assures mining investors of reforms and clear rules
results.content: Lands and Natural Resources Minister Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah has called on investors, financiers, technology partners and international development institutions to invest in Ghana, assuring them of the country’s commitment to reforming the management of its mineral wealth while ensuring that its benefits are shared more widely.

results.title: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways
results.content: Elon Musk's SpaceX and artificial intelligence giant Anthropic have pledged big financial giveaways as Big Tech firms come under pressure over the potential impact of AI on humanity.

results.title: Kwadaso Assembly plants 400 royal palms to promote green environment
results.content: The Kwadaso Municipal Assembly has embarked on a large-scale tree planting exercise at Diamond Valley, a sub-community of Denkyemuoso, as part of its efforts to mitigate the effects of climate change and promote a green environment.

results.title: Gov’t seizes 8,200 items in galamsey fight, including 135 excavators – Mahama
results.content: President John Mahama says his government has confiscated 8,200 items used in illegal mining, commonly known as galamsey, across the country.

results.title: Tension over alleged bloated voters’ register at Atwima Kwanwoma NDC ahead of constituency elections
results.content: Tension is mounting within the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in the Atwima Kwanwoma Constituency of the Ashanti Region, following concerns raised by the party’s women’s wing over an alleged bloated voters’ register ahead of Saturday’s constituency elections.

results.title: GFA labels Björkegren ‘best-performing coach’ to justify Black Stars appointment

results.title: Court of Appeal halts former NAFCO boss’s trial over charge sheet challenge
results.content: The Court of Appeal has halted the trial of former Chief Executive Officer of the National Food and Buffer Stock Company (NAFCO), Hanan Abdul-Wahab Aludiba, pending the determination of his appeal challenging the charge sheet.

results.title: Mining must benefit communities without destroying their environment – Lands Minister
results.content: Lands and Natural Resources Minister Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah has described responsible mining as a key measure of Ghana’s progress, stressing that mineral extraction must benefit local communities without leaving them to bear the environmental and social costs.

results.title: Poor sanitation and menstrual stigma threaten girls’ dignity in rural Ghana – REEP Ghana
results.content: The Executive Director of REEP Ghana, Hairiya Bala, has decried the deplorable state of sanitation facilities and entrenched menstrual stigma that continue to strip girls and women, especially in rural Ghana, of their dignity and right to safe menstrual health management.

results.title: Judgement day for Kenya pastor accused of ordering parents to starve their children to death

results.title: I countersigned $2m Skytrain payment, but Covid-19 stalled project – Ameyaw Ekumfi
results.content: Former Board Chairman of the Ghana Infrastructure Investment Fund (GIIF), Professor Christopher Ameyaw Ekumfi, says he countersigned an instruction authorising a $2 million payment for the Skytrain project, but the Covid-19 pandemic disrupted its implementation.

results.title: Africa must control its mineral development agenda – AU Commissioner
results.content: African Union Commissioner for Economic Development, Trade, Tourism, Industry and Minerals, Francisca Belobe, has called on African countries to take greater control of their mineral development priorities and ensure that the continent derives more value from its natural resources.

results.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base moved a kilometre ‘in 30 to 60 seconds’
results.content: The fire that killed four members of the Canadian military and injured dozens of others on Saturday spread with alarming speed, accounts suggest.

results.title: Ghana’s Lithium Promise: A fading dream?
